consequence.statement: Disabling the wsl_v5 linter changes only how Crossplane's source code is checked during development; operators don't need to do anything.

assertion.statement: The wsl_v5 linter was disabled in Crossplane's development tooling; this has no operational effect on running Crossplane installations.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the change is to a source-code linter in the project's development tooling, which is not an operator-facing setting; no subject family fits; change: the linter is internal build tooling, not a configuration surface of the released product, so no typed change applies; applicability: no customer-environment configuration relates to an internal development linter
